$comment: Seed questions for the launch pool. Selected by Ashley Childress. Inserted with participant_id = NULL so they belong to no participant and never surface in a personal history view (spec FR-028). Ids are uuid5 over namespace 6f1b6a2e-9c3d-5f47-8b21-0d4a7c9e2f10 and displayText, so reseeding is idempotent and anyone can regenerate them.

questions.displayText: What's the one thing you keep in your car or your bag that's bailed you out more than once?
What do you wish somebody had told you before your first review got torn apart?
How do you tell a friend you can't afford the thing they just invited you to?
How do you turn down helping someone move without it costing you the friendship?
How do you bring up moving a parent closer without it sounding like you're taking over their life?
How do you let someone help you without feeling like you owe them something back?
